Ensure the standard FENG corporation exists for controlled fresh-world fixture

data.sql: INSERT INTO corporations(name,owner_id,tag) VALUES ('Ferengi Alliance',107,'FENG') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Create Ferengi captain NPC fixture

data.sql: INSERT INTO players(name,passwd,sector_id,credits,type,is_npc,commission_id) VALUES ('V3 Ferengi captain QA','$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=3,p=1$m9e+qkJe5du1SC25jkIB0A$fd2PpiLEjU5d2AXlAf1nznGko41GPU7Z2jxX3gX0QZE',201,0,2,TRUE,1);

tests.name: Create captain-class Dreadnought NPC ship

data.sql: INSERT INTO ships(name,type_id,sector_id,holds,fighters,shields,hull,personality,destroyed) SELECT 'V3 Ferengi QA captain Dreadnought',shiptypes_id,201,10,0,100,100,'defensive',FALSE FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Ferengi Dreadnought';

tests.name: Assign Dreadnought to the Ferengi captain NPC

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name='V3 Ferengi QA captain Dreadnought'),(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='V3 Ferengi captain QA'),1,TRUE;

tests.name: Register distinct Dreadnought captain in Ferengi roster

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_traders(trader_code,display_name,corporation_id,ship_id) SELECT 'v3_qa_captain','V3 QA Ferengi Captain',corporation_id,(SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name='V3 Ferengi QA captain Dreadnought') FROM corporations WHERE tag='FENG';

data.sql: SELECT 200;

tests.name: Create NPC player for genuine Ferengi ship

data.sql: INSERT INTO players(name,passwd,sector_id,credits,type,is_npc,commission_id) VALUES ('V3 Ferengi QA NPC captain','$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=3,p=1$m9e+qkJe5du1SC25jkIB0A$fd2PpiLEjU5d2AXlAf1nznGko41GPU7Z2jxX3gX0QZE',@{battle_sector},0,2,TRUE,1);

data.sql: INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) SELECT corporation_id,(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='V3 Ferengi QA NPC captain'),'Officer' FROM corporations WHERE tag='FENG';

tests.name: Establish NPC ship ownership

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE name='V3 Ferengi QA warship'),(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='V3 Ferengi QA NPC captain'),1,TRUE;

tests.name: Refresh hunter session at combat sector
Save strongest active Ferengi captain before the hostile encounter

data.sql: SELECT ft.ship_id FROM ferengi_traders ft JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=ft.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE ft.active=TRUE AND COALESCE(s.destroyed,FALSE)=FALSE AND COALESCE(s.hull,0)>0 ORDER BY COALESCE(st.maxattack,0) DESC,COALESCE(s.hull,0) DESC,COALESCE(s.shields,0) DESC,ft.ferengi_trader_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Ordinary player attacks genuine Ferengi NPC without destroying it
Nonlethal attack posts one wanted bounty and the strongest captain receives hunt intelligence

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bounties WHERE posted_by_type='npc' AND posted_by_id=(SELECT corporation_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship}) AND target_type='player' AND target_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND reward=5000 AND status='open')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM npc_action_log WHERE idempotency_key='ferengi:hostile:'||(SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship})||':'||(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND status='completed')::int,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM npc_intelligence i WHERE i.target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND i.source='ferengi_hunt' AND i.npc_ship_id=@{expected_ferengi_captain_ship})::int;

tests.name: Repeated nonlethal attack records no duplicate wanted bounty
Repeated attack preserves one bounty and one completed wanted action

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bounties WHERE posted_by_type='npc' AND target_type='player' AND target_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND reward=5000)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM npc_action_log WHERE idempotency_key='ferengi:hostile:'||(SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship})||':'||(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter'))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM npc_intelligence WHERE source='ferengi_hunt' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND npc_ship_id=@{expected_ferengi_captain_ship})::int;

tests.name: Set the genuinely damaged target up for the lethal destruction acceptance

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET hull=10,shields=0 WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship};

tests.name: Ordinary player destroys genuine Ferengi NPC
Authenticated player session reports exact 5000-credit award
Verify authoritative destruction and source/recipient ledger

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT destroyed AND hull=0 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship})::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(recipient_player_id)=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND MIN(amount)=5000 AND MIN(source)='system_generated' FROM ferengi_destruction_rewards WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship})::int,(SELECT credits=@{credits_before}+5000 FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter')::int;

tests.name: Retry after destruction is rejected and cannot award again
Verify retry did not duplicate reward

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ferengi_destruction_rewards WHERE ship_id=@{ferengi_ship})=1 AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter')=@{credits_before}+5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

data.sql: INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) SELECT c.corporation_id,p.player_id,'Officer' FROM corporations c CROSS JOIN players p WHERE c.tag='FENG' AND p.name='v3_human_feng_owner' ON CONFLICT(corporation_id,player_id) DO NOTHING;

data.sql: WITH human AS (SELECT player_id,ship_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_human_feng_owner'), moved_player AS (UPDATE players p SET sector_id=@{battle_sector} FROM human h WHERE p.player_id=h.player_id RETURNING p.player_id,p.ship_id), moved_ship AS (UPDATE ships s SET name='Human Ferengi corporation ship',type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Ferengi Warship'),sector_id=@{battle_sector},holds=10,fighters=0,shields=0,hull=10,personality='defensive',destroyed=FALSE FROM moved_player p WHERE s.ship_id=p.ship_id RETURNING s.ship_id) SELECT ship_id FROM moved_ship;
